_comentario: MODELO TEENS. Aula 20 = LEITURA (aula par) no formato CONVERSA (atualizacao 01/10/2026 do CURRICULO): tempos da narrativa para montar a cena (was / were + -ing para o cenario, past simple para o que corta, while, e had been + -ing para ha quanto tempo). Junta os pontos das antigas aulas 15 e 16 (past continuous; past continuous x past simple com when/while, escritos em B1) elevados para B2 com o past perfect continuous. Tema bloco F (series e filmes); fato dono: o que ela ve e por que prefere ver sozinha. Leitura sempre em voz alta, juntas. Video em aula (Michelle Schusterman, YouTube nocookie). Vozes iguais as aulas 1-19.

lesson.grammar_point: narrative tenses: past continuous for the scene, past simple for the interruption (when / while), past perfect continuous (had been + -ing) for duration

listenings.text: Sophia, it's Ruby. I finally watched the season finale! I had been trying to watch it since Saturday, and last night it worked. I was sitting in the kitchen, my mom was making tea, and nobody was talking. And the cliffhanger? Wow. Don't worry, no spoilers! But tell me, what were you watching last weekend? You always watch alone, right? Call me back!

paras: It was Saturday night, and I had been binge-watching my favorite series for three hours. My little brother was playing video games in the living room, my mom was cooking pasta, and I was lying on my bed with a blanket and a bowl of popcorn. I had been waiting all week for the season finale.

The last episode was getting really good. The detective was opening a mysterious door, the music was getting louder, and then the screen froze. Buffering. I had been looking forward to that moment for months, and now I was staring at a little spinning circle. The Wi-Fi was down!

I ran to the living room. My brother had been downloading a huge game all night, and he hadn’t told anyone. While we were arguing, my best friend sent me a message with a spoiler. So now I know the plot twist, and I still haven’t seen the cliffhanger. Lesson learned: I watch alone, with my phone off.
